exposure: Perinatal asphyxia due to other causes
outcome: Neurodevelopmental outcome (NDO) (abnormal defined as cerebral palsy with Gross Motor Function Classification System >=III and/or a Bayley Scales of Infant and Toddler Development, third edition (BSID-III) composite score < 85)
cohort: The study included 111 infants with moderate to severe hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy treated with therapeutic hypothermia, born between May 2009 and October 2015.
finding: Infants with perinatal anemia had a higher risk for neonatal mortality (OR 3.33), but all survivors in the anemia group showed a normal neurodevelopmental outcome, in contrast to 38% of the non-anemic group who had neurodevelopmental impairments.
